method: Read saved answers, actual final contexts, pinned source files and existing validation references. No new generation, no independent judge, no code execution as evidence. Qualitative diagnosis only; no aggregate answer accuracy.

cases.diagnosis: Both answers correctly say Node nanoid(-10) throws and cite its actual test. Both incorrectly substitute the sibling random(bytes) check at index.js:18-21 for the nanoid implementation. The target size check at index.js:136-138 was never shown. Entry filtering prevents switching to another entry but does not bind the requested symbol to its implementation.
cases.next_action: Resolve the requested symbol within the selected entry and read its implementation and matching test assertion, rather than relying on a similar helper.

cases.support: test assertion supports conclusion; implementation explanation incomplete
cases.diagnosis: Both answers correctly deny lowercasing and cite the case-normalization test at test/index_test.ts:79-90. Neither explains Map.get(type)/Map.set(type, ...) from src/index.ts:66-73. The off run saw those implementation lines; the auto run did not. More tools and an available expert did not improve completeness.
cases.next_action: Evaluate required-fact coverage separately from the headline conclusion and from source coverage.

cases.diagnosis: Both correctly describe cancellation for either a CancelJob instance or the class itself, citing the actual Scheduler._run_job condition. Both use three local requests, with no delegation.
cases.next_action: Keep this as a supported example; it does not establish general multi-agent benefit.

cases.diagnosis: The SDK actually invoked inspect_tests for three model calls within the shared six-call episode. The final answer claims separate foo/FOO emit assertions, but its citations point to event type declarations, one foo registration test and a Map type alias. These lines do not assert emission behavior. The case-normalization assertion at test/index_test.ts:79-90 was omitted from the final context. A valid citation range and a working specialist are not semantic acceptance.
cases.next_action: Improve assertion selection and citation entailment before enabling specialists by default.

cases.diagnosis: Both correctly say negative size throws in Node. Both falsely describe bitwise |= 0 as conversion to an unsigned integer, and substitute random(bytes) for the requested nanoid implementation. The second turn reuses one verified test span, makes zero tool calls and two model requests, but repeats the earlier incorrect explanation. Its final context does not contain the claimed random implementation. Source reuse is demonstrated; factual consistency is not solved.
cases.next_action: Track the target symbol and unresolved support gaps; check new claims against the current raw context, not previous model prose.

cases.main_conclusion: correct for the newly selected entry
cases.diagnosis: The entry switches from Node to non-secure, no old span is admitted, and the model reads non-secure/index.js. It correctly explains that a negative initial i makes while (i-- > 0) skip the loop and return an empty string. The brief comparison with Node relies on prior conversation; Node source is not reintroduced as current-entry evidence.
cases.next_action: Keep the entry-switch regression and add explicit cross-entry comparison cases in the next batch.

cases.diagnosis: Explorer completes. Mentor reads source but its next research input requires an estimated 8658 tokens including a 2048-token output allowance and 128-token reserve, exceeding the 8192 limit. That request is not sent. Contributor never runs. No complete report quality or cost win can be reported.
cases.next_action: Bound research-stage context, including tool schemas and accumulated observations, and fall back through the SDK to a compact finalizer when safe. Preserve this failed attempt.

cases.diagnosis: Explorer reuses the identical cached attempt. Mentor receives the verified src/index.ts span, but invents an unobserved test/index_test.ts reading step and uses dependencies as a dependencyGraph path key. The output guardrail rejects both. The partial output also contains unsupported free-text assertions; path validation alone is not correctness. Contributor never runs.
cases.next_action: Separate proposed reading candidates from verified report paths and guide the SDK to fill required source gaps before finalization. Do not strip invalid claims and relabel the failed output successful.

decision: Keep single-agent mode off as default. SDK collaboration and source reuse are engineering capabilities, not proven quality gains. Complete symbol-level context handling and bounded report research, then evaluate independent semantic quality before P7.
